network.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notFound.lead: The link you opened doesn't exist, has been renamed, or is an old link that's no longer valid.

offlinePage.body: The CatCheck interface is stored on your device, so it still opens without a connection. But anything from the server — new scans, history, reminders, your cats' profiles — needs a connection to load or send.
offlinePage.statusOnline: You're back online. Reload the page to continue.
offlinePage.statusOffline: Offline — can't reach the server yet.
offlinePage.tipsTitle: While you wait for a connection
offlinePage.tip1: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then tap Reload page.
offlinePage.tip2: The photo you just took hasn't been sent and CatCheck doesn't keep an offline queue yet — please scan again once you're back online.
offlinePage.tip3: If you've added CatCheck to your home screen, reopening it from that icon gives the same result as this page.
